arguments.text: Bug #1 fixed: in `Option.__init__`, the implicit `default = False` for flags was also applied to `required=True` flags, so a missing required flag was never detected. Now it only applies when the flag is not required. `--foo` (is_flag, required) now errors with "Missing option '--foo'" when omitted, and the full test suite (488 passed) is still green.
On it — investigating echo with no streams (_compat/_termui_impl/utils).
On it — investigating envvar + flag_value handling in core.py.
On it — investigating the argument decorator preserving cls.
